headline: Google’s deepfake detector system used to debunk McConnell hoax pic
context: Earlier this week, a picture seemed to show Kentucky Senator Mitch McConnell covered in tubes in a hospital bed in a state of extreme distress. It turned out to be an AI-generated fake.
